module.Title: Combine Safety Conditions
module.Teaching: The and operator requires both conditions to be True. It is useful for equipment permissives.
module.ExampleCode:
if guard_closed and motor_ready:
    print("Start permitted")
module.TargetCode:
if door_closed and pressure_normal:
    print("System ready")
module.PredictionQuestion: What must be true for the message to run?
module.PredictionExplanation: and returns True only when both sides are True.
module.BrokenCode:
if door_closed or pressure_normal:
    print("System ready")
module.DebugPrompt: or would allow the system to proceed when only one permissive is satisfied.
module.RecallPrompt: Write the two-condition system-ready check. Use these exact identifiers: door_closed, pressure_normal, print. Use the exact value "System ready".
module.TransferPrompt: Allow pump start only when level_ok and overload_ok are both True. Use the exact identifier print. Use the exact value "Pump start permitted".
module.TransferCode:
if level_ok and overload_ok:
    print("Pump start permitted")
module.PreviewMessage: Multiple safety permissives can now be evaluated together.
